ui.money.title: Accounts
ui.money.hint: Bank, cash, wallet and investment accounts, with their UPI IDs and ledger balances.
ui.money.col.name: Name
ui.money.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
ui.money.upiHint: Optional. Used for UPI payment links to this account.
ui.money.ledgerHint: Optional. Enter the code of an existing asset account, such as BANK, to attach this account to it. Leave empty to create a new ledger account.
ui.money.custodianHint: Optional. The person or body that holds the account.
ui.money.badKey: Use lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
ui.money.badUpi: Enter a UPI ID such as name@bank.
ui.money.balancesHint: Changing the date recalculates every account as on that day. Closed accounts are left out.
ui.money.badAmount: Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
ui.money.overrideReasonHint: For example: cheque deposit clears tomorrow
ui.money.overdrawWarning: {name} would go below zero. It does not allow a negative balance. The reason is saved in the audit log.
ui.money.reasonNeeded: Enter a reason to continue. It is saved in the audit log.
ui.money.rangeOrder: The from date is after the to date.
ui.money.noLines: Nothing was posted to this account between these dates.
ui.money.tb.title: Trial balance
ui.money.tb.intro: Every account in the books with its balance on one day. Debit and credit totals must be equal: that is the check that the books are in order.
ui.money.tb.yearNote: Money, debts and funds carry forward from earlier years. Income and expenses are for the financial year {year} only.
ui.money.tb.badNote: Debit and credit differ by {amount}. This should not happen. Do not rely on these figures; contact support with the date shown.
ui.money.tb.balancedNote: Debit and credit are equal. Every entry in the books has equal debit and credit lines, so this should always be so.
ui.money.tb.empty: No entries on or before {date}. Entries appear here once donations, claims or transfers are recorded.
ui.money.reconcile.title: Reconcile
ui.money.reconcile.importHint: Download your statement from the bank as a CSV file and choose it here. You tell the app which column is which, check the preview, and then import. Importing the same lines twice is safe: lines already here are skipped.
ui.money.reconcile.dropHint: The file is read in your browser. Nothing is sent until you press Import.
ui.money.reconcile.amountSingle: One amount column; negative means money out
ui.money.reconcile.amountSplit: Separate Money out and Money in columns
ui.money.reconcile.remember: Remember this setup for this account
ui.money.reconcile.rememberHint: Saved in this browser, for next time.
ui.money.reconcile.setup.date: Choose which column holds the date.
ui.money.reconcile.setup.description: Choose which column holds the description.
ui.money.reconcile.setup.amount: Choose the amount column, or the Money out and Money in columns.
ui.money.reconcile.setup.twice: Each kind of column can be used once. Two columns are set to the same thing.
ui.money.reconcile.problem.bothAmounts: Has both money in and money out
ui.money.reconcile.leftOut.one: 1 row has a problem and will be left out.
ui.money.reconcile.leftOut.other: {count} rows have a problem and will be left out.
ui.money.reconcile.imported: Imported. {added} added, {duplicates} already here and skipped, {matched} matched automatically. {need} still need a decision.
ui.money.reconcile.emptyFile: The file has no lines. The first row should be the column headings, followed by the lines.
ui.money.reconcile.unreadable: That file could not be read.
ui.money.reconcile.panel.match: Match to an entry in your books
ui.money.reconcile.panel.book: Record this line in your books
ui.money.reconcile.matchHint: Only entries for exactly the same amount that no other line has taken are listed.
ui.money.reconcile.noEntries: No entry in your books has this amount. If the bank did something you had not recorded, such as a charge or interest, use Book instead.
ui.money.reconcile.bookHint: This adds an entry dated on the statement line, for example a bank charge or interest the books did not have, and pairs it with the line.
ui.money.reconcile.ignoreHint: Use this only for lines that are not the organisation's money, or that the file repeated. The note is kept with the line.
ui.money.reconcile.empty.unmatched: Every line is matched, booked or ignored.
ui.money.reconcile.likelyHint: The highlighted button is the likely choice: Match when your books have an entry of the same amount, Book when they have none.
ui.money.reconcile.pickAccount: Choose what this line was for.
ui.money.reconcile.needNote: Say why this line is ignored.
ui.money.reconcile.compareHint: Enter the closing balance printed on the bank statement and the day it is for. The app shows how your books compare. You can sign off only when every line is settled and the difference is zero.
ui.money.reconcile.badBalance: Enter the balance as a number, such as 212400.00.
ui.money.reconcile.outstanding: Entries in the books not yet on the statement
ui.money.reconcile.unbooked: Statement lines not yet in the books
ui.money.reconcile.reconciled: Reconciled. Every statement line is settled and the difference is zero.
ui.money.reconcile.needFigures: Enter the statement balance and press Compare.
ui.money.reconcile.alreadySigned: This account is already signed off up to {date}. Choose a later day.
ui.money.reconcile.stillUnmatched.one: 1 statement line is still unmatched. Match, book or ignore it first.
ui.money.reconcile.stillUnmatched.other: {count} statement lines are still unmatched. Match, book or ignore them first.
ui.money.reconcile.differs: The books and the statement differ by {amount}. Find the difference before signing off.
ui.money.reconcile.signLimit: Signing off locks the statement lines up to that day. It does not stop an entry being added to the books for an earlier day; only closing the financial year does that.
